info.title: v2.product.get_ssp_detail
info.description:
Get the details of an SSP or CSSP. At least one of ssp_id and cssp_id is required, and cssp_id takes priority when both are provided.

The response covers the product content such as the category path, attributes, brand and variations. Each entry in cssps is a country-specific SSP under the SSP, and its tier_indices point to the selected options of the parent tier_variation.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/get_ssp_detail?access_token=[REDACTED_SECRET]&cssp_id=400012701718692&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=[REDACTED_SECRET]&ssp_id=22865&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
